goal: A director should read five blocks and know: how the pilot is doing, what moved, what is waiting on the board, and what the platform cannot yet say.

candidates.name: Interpret-led, capital first
candidates.rationale: Board priorities are capital, margin, risk; the page policy leads Board 360 with interpret; the one decision pending is a capital item, so trigger comes second.

candidates.name: Trigger-led
candidates.conditions: Re-enter when more than one decision is pending on the board seat, or one is overdue.

candidates.name: Report-led
candidates.rationale: Board 360 is not a status board; report leads on Watch State and Training Run pages, not here (page policy).

manifest.assumption: Reader is a board director with capital/margin/risk priorities
Exactly one decision is pending on the board seat
